item.title: Ensuring Transparency and Athlete Representation: National Sports Governance (National Sports Bodies) Rules, 2026
item.description: Sports Ministry has notified the National Sports Governance (National Sports Bodies) Rules, 2026, introducing a framework to ensure transparency, accountability, gender equality, and athlete participation in sports governance.
